note: The English bio cites John 14:6 by reference only (rendered Yokaana 14:6) and quotes no scripture verbatim; the hymn line and Graham's own words are translated as prose.

Names and institutions keep their English forms as the shipped lg bios do (Billy Graham Evangelistic Association, Modesto Manifesto, Just As I Am, Christianity Today); evangelist = omubuulizi w’enjiri, crusade = olukuŋŋaana olunene. The epitaph's 'four plain words' is rendered 'ebigambo ebyangu' without the number, since the epitaph is not four words in Luganda.

Quotation marks mirror the source (straight in the bio and FAQ, curly in the short bio). The FAQ carries facts not in the long bio (Chattanooga 1953, Parkinson's, Christianity Today 1956, the 1997 autobiography), translated as given.
